description: Maya holds the key to a family storage unit and must decide where several meaningful and bulky items go during a Saturday cleanout, with input from three relatives.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Storage Unit Key-Holder and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family storage unit contains an antique writing desk, two matching brass lamps, a set of burgundy stage curtains, twelve banker boxes of family papers, and four folding chairs.
shared_context.S2: The storage unit must be cleared during the family's Saturday cleanout.
shared_context.S3: Maya has the key and will make the final decisions about where the items go and how they leave the unit.
shared_context.S4: The family usually does a quick round of practical check-ins before a cleanout so everyone can mention plans that affect what gets moved, kept, or donated.
shared_context.S5: The family wants meaningful items preserved when there is a workable home for them, while unclaimed materials may be donated.

PF1.text: Jonah spoke with the director of Riverside Community Theater, who confirmed that the theater will take the burgundy stage curtains if Jonah delivers them there on August 12, 2027; this arrangement has not reached the group.

PF2.text: Rosa measured the doorway of Omar's new house at 90 centimeters, and Omar told her he wants the antique writing desk there; the desk is 78 centimeters wide, and Omar's offer has not reached the group.

PF3.text: Cal received confirmation from Helping Hands that its truck will pick up exactly the twelve banker boxes on August 10, 2027, but the pickup has not been arranged with the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The burgundy stage curtains must go to Riverside Community Theater and be delivered on August 12, 2027.
The antique writing desk must go to Omar's house.
All twelve banker boxes must go to Helping Hands.
A commitment to deliver the curtains to Riverside Community Theater on August 12, 2027 must exist.
A commitment to arrange the Helping Hands pickup on August 10, 2027 must exist.
The settlement must cite the private arrangements that justify the curtains, desk, and banker-box decisions.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'delivery' and (('Riverside Community Theater' in c['target']) or ('Riverside Community Theater' in c['detail'])) and (('August 12, 2027' in c['detail']) or ('August 12th' in c['detail']) or ('August 12' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'pickup' and (('Helping Hands' in c['target']) or ('Helping Hands' in c['detail'])) and (('August 10, 2027' in c['detail']) or ('August 10th' in c['detail']) or ('August 10' in c['detail'])) and (('twelve banker boxes' in c['detail']) or ('12 banker boxes' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jonah's theater arrangement changes the curtains destination to Riverside Community Theater, fixes delivery to August 12, 2027, and creates the required delivery commitment.
Rosa's measurement and Omar's offer change the desk destination to Omar's house, whose 90-centimeter doorway accommodates the 78-centimeter desk.
Cal's Helping Hands confirmation changes the banker-box destination to Helping Hands, fixes the quantity at exactly twelve boxes, and creates the August 10 pickup commitment.
